name: UnysonPlus-AI-Dev-Kit
description: Version marker for the AI Dev Kit. Bump kit_version (+0.0.1, cap/cascade at 99) whenever one of the tracked components below is updated, and set its recorded version, so the kit recognizes it carries an update. Only the conversion tooling triggers a kit bump.
bump_rule: When UnysonPlus-Capture-Service OR the UnysonPlus Site Converter extension is updated, bump kit_version and set the matching entry under "bump_triggers" to the new version. Plugin core and parent theme are also bundled by assemble.ps1 but do NOT trigger a kit bump (they have their own updaters).

reference_only.note: Bundled by assemble.ps1 for completeness; NOT bump triggers.
